title: Contract Pricing Agreement: Contract Item List Rules
content:
## Contract item list rules — Contract Pricing Agreement

**In force**

(a) *Live agreements only.* Contract items are added only to an agreement whose status is active or renewal pending, as the agreement record shows.

(b) *Counting the quote validity.* Calendar days of a special pricing quote's validity are counted starting the day after the quote date; acceptance on the last day is valid, and a later acceptance needs a new quote.

(c) *Usage and list size.* An item is added only when its expected annual usage is at least the tier's minimum annual units, in selling units, and only while the number of contract items the agreement carries stays at or below the tier's largest item count. The number of contract items carried on a date is the count of distinct item numbers whose latest contract item price line effective on or before that date is an addition or a repricing, not a removal. A tier whose largest item count is 0 carries no contract items.

(d) *Smallest list and review.* An agreement on a tier with contract items carries at least the tier's smallest number of contract items, and its contract items are reviewed every market-basket review interval, in months, of the tier.

**Clauses no longer in force (superseded by the current basis)**

(e) Retired: "An item is added at the price of an accepted Corbett special pricing quote, returned within the tier's special pricing request period in business days of the request; the quote is accepted no later than the tier's special pricing quote validity period in calendar days after the quote date."

(f) Retired: "Corbett removes an item only after giving the tier's contract item removal notice in calendar days, counted from the notice date; a customer may ask for removal of an item effective the next ship date."

(g) Retired: "When the manufacturer discontinues a contract item, the Corbett-approved substitute is billed at the discontinued item's contract unit price for the tier's discontinued item price protection period in days from the discontinuation and is then added at its own quoted price or reverts to the discount basis."

### Quote validity counting, boundary cases (hypothetical 30 day validity)

| Acceptance day, counted from the day after the quote date | Result under (b) |
|---|---|
| Day 30 (the last day) | Valid |
| Day 31 | Needs a new quote |

superseded_clauses: An item is added at the price of an accepted Corbett special pricing quote, returned within special_pricing_request_business_days business days of the request; the quote is accepted no later than special_pricing_quote_validity_days calendar days after the quote date.

Corbett removes an item only after giving contract_item_removal_notice_days calendar days of notice, counted from the notice date; a customer may ask for removal of an item effective the next ship date.

When the manufacturer discontinues a contract item, the Corbett-approved substitute is billed at the discontinued item's contract unit price for discontinued_item_price_protection_days days from the discontinuation and is then added at its own quoted price or reverts to the discount basis.
